name: ClaimDecisions
$note: The WHOLE thing you write — a decision TABLE read like a spreadsheet. `inputs`/`outputs` are the columns (name + simple type); each `rule` is a row: `when` = input cells keyed by input name, `then` = output cells keyed by output name. No FEEL, no DMN XML, no namespaces. A missing input in `when` = 'any'. decisionToDmn / fromEngineProject synthesize the DMN 1.2 file: FEEL cell text, typeRefs, inputData/decisionTable, hitPolicy, namespace. A `rule` node with dmn:{model:'ClaimDecisions',decision:'Eligibility'} fires it. See scenarios.md §0; model.json shows the jBPM-side DMN XML tree this produces (the escape hatch).
